story.title: BRICS Leaders Gather in India to Discuss Trade and Global Conflicts
story.summary: Leaders of the BRICS nations, including Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Chinese President Xi Jinping, convened in New Delhi for a summit focused on trade, investment, and global conflicts. The meeting aims to enhance the bloc's influence in shaping the global agenda for emerging and developing countries.

timeline_highlights.title: Leaders Gather in India for High-Stakes BRICS Summit Amid Global Tensions
timeline_highlights.summary: Leaders from Iran, Russia, and China are attending the BRICS summit in New Delhi, where India is working to balance its relationships with these nations amid ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East. The summit is expected to address the challenges posed by these tensions and test the unity of the group.

India is navigating competing interests amid the Ukraine and Middle East wars.
The summit aims to address challenges to the group's unity.

event_overview.title: About BRICS Summit
event_overview.subject: BRICS Summit
event_overview.summary: The BRICS Summit is the leaders’ meeting of BRICS, a political and diplomatic coordination forum of major emerging and developing economies that works across global governance, economic and financial cooperation, and people-to-people exchanges. The 18th summit is being held under India’s 2026 chairship, bringing member-country leaders together with partner countries and other invited participants.

facts.label: Dates and venue
facts.value: The 18th BRICS Summit is scheduled for 12–13 September 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi, India.

facts.label: Host and chairship
facts.value: India holds the 2026 BRICS chairship and is hosting the summit; its stated chairship theme is “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability.”

facts.label: Membership
facts.value: BRICS has 11 full members: Brazil, China, Egypt, Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Iran, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa and the United Arab Emirates.

facts.label: Institutional form
facts.value: BRICS is an informal coordination mechanism rather than a treaty-based organization: it has no constitutive treaty, permanent secretariat or independent budget, and its presidency rotates among members.

facts.label: Participation and decisions
facts.value: Full members participate in all BRICS meetings and make decisions by consensus; partner countries may be invited to leaders’ and foreign-ministers’ meetings and other sessions subject to member consultation and consensus.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline covers developments surrounding the New Delhi leaders’ gathering on 11–12 September 2026, not the summit’s full two-day program, every bilateral meeting, or all final outcomes and declarations.

related_stories.title: Trump Expresses Support for a Unified Ireland During Visit
related_stories.summary: During his visit to Ireland, President Donald Trump stated that he would 'love' to see Ireland reunified, calling it 'fantastic' and 'inevitable.' His comments were made while attending the Irish Open golf tournament and meeting with Irish leaders, including Micheál Martin. Trump suggested that reunification could happen soon, despite Downing Street's commitment to the Good Friday Agreement.

related_stories.title: Tributes to 9/11 Victims at Republican Convention in Dallas
related_stories.summary: At the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, tributes were paid to the victims of the September 11, 2001 attacks. President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance participated in the remembrance, with Trump also scheduled to deliver a speech at the Pentagon on the same day.
